#MSNews | The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority has carried out large-scale clearing operations throughout Metro Manila on Thursday, resulting in the apprehension of 174 vehicles, with 40 of these being impounded due to illegal parking and obstruction.

The operation, spearheaded by the MMDA Special Operations Group-Task Force for Road Clearing (SOG-TFRC), specifically targeted the areas that have been plagued by chronic gridlock.

Additionally, the operation resulted in the removal of fixtures that were encroaching upon sidewalks.

📷 MMDA

data.text:
Buti talaga hindi maulan ngayon. Thank you Lord! Dahil mabilis magbaha pa naman dyan malapit sa airport at lalo na dyan sa Roxas Blvd if papunta silang Cubao area to take the Skyway. Nakakahiya talaga pag inabot sila ng traffic or mastranded sila. Sana makapagliwaliw sila after FSE. Punta sila Intramuros, SM MOA area, or BGC area. Alam kong gusto nating batuhin ng itlog si TR pero Ialay na lang po natin yung itlog sa Monasteryo ng Sta. CLARA sa Marikina para hindi umulan atleast while they are here. 👍 
Wala po ako sa Fancon dahil hindi nakasecure ng tix and sa FSE. Pero i am so excited for fellow Ahofies na mapapanood sila. Kaya nagpunta na lang ako ng airport kanina para makita sila kaya i am all satisfied. Guys, sinasabi ko sa inyo, pag nakita nyo sila. Mawawala  ka sa katinuan. Sobrang nagniningning yung aura nila. Apakapogi! Sobra pa dun, i cant explain it! Please also protect our boys if nasa public sila. Do not make LIVE videos or pictures. Keep it to yourself muna until makauwi sila. Also refrain asking for selfie unless they volunteer. Give them space and let them enjoy Manila. I know masmaraming nakakakilala sa kanila dito kaya please protect them. Sa japan mas nakakagala sila dahil puro turista ang andun so naenjoy nila ang osaka. LEts give them the same space and privacy they need para makapag destress and relax sila sa dami nang mga naging sked nila recently. THEY NEDD IT. THEY DESERVE IT.
WELCOME TO THE PHILIPPINES AHOF
